items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Naturally Ovie Alston had gone, you know.

ctx.x: I know everybody that was in the band. Why can't I think of them? I cannot think.

Naturally Ovie Alston had gone, you know. He used to be there years ago, because he was the band. Bobby -- Bobby Johnson, Tenor saxophone player, yeah. I'll put it that way, and I'm trying to think who was playing the alto then, but Rudy -- we weren't together, but he had to have been in that band.
Tenor man, who used to be with Charlie --
